candidate.description: Join path for PROC-400 DOL Views (executable process) to the organizational spine via HEIR identity fields. The process document at factory/outreach/400-dol-views attaches to the imo-creator sovereign through ctb_placement (leaf), cc_layer (CC-04), and sovereign_ref (imo-creator-v2). Join resolves despite 3 identity field inconsistencies between heir.yaml and PROCESS.md. Run 1 of minimum 3 — proposal only, no lock.

join_path.spine: imo-creator sovereign → STRUCTURE_MANIFEST.yaml CTB tree → factory/outreach/400-dol-views

ctb_position_exists.evidence: Directory exists with PROCESS.md, CLAUDE.md, heir.yaml, src/001_dol_views.sql

sovereign_ref_resolves.evidence: imo-creator-v2 is the active sovereign repo (CC-01 in FLEET_REGISTRY)

cc_layer_valid.evidence: CC-04 is a valid layer in the concentric circle model

hub_id_resolves.evidence: Both refer to the same process at the same CTB position. Join resolves by position, but the ID conflict must be reconciled — one canonical hub_id required for agent routing

orbt_state_consistent.evidence: State conflict between heir.yaml (build) and PROCESS.md §1 (OPERATE). Agents checking ORBT from different files will get different answers. Does not break the join path but breaks state routing.

data_join_chain.field: OSAM L9 join chain (data-level, not process-level)
data_join_chain.evidence: Data-level join chain declared in PROCESS.md §5. Would require database query to verify resolution. Not in scope for process-to-organizational-spine join evaluation.

join_key_inconsistencies.measurement: Count of HEIR/identity fields with conflicting values between heir.yaml and PROCESS.md. Each inconsistency is a field where two authoritative files disagree on the value for the same named position. (1) process_id: PROC-DOL vs PROC-400, (2) status/ORBT: build vs OPERATE, (3) sovereign_ref: imo-creator-v2 (heir.yaml) vs imo-creator (01-orchestrator.json heir block).

unresolvable_spine_hops.measurement: Count of hops in the join chain (process → ctb_position → sub_hub → business_silo → sovereign) where the target entity does not exist or cannot be verified. All 4 hops resolve: ctb_position exists on disk, outreach sub-hub exists in STRUCTURE_MANIFEST, svg-agency silo exists in FLEET_REGISTRY, sovereign imo-creator-v2 is the active repo.

orphan_layer_count.measurement: Count of 17 mapped elements from 03-map.json where the target layer has no declared position on the CTB tree. All 24 target layers (L1-L24) have positions defined in the US handoff invariant set. The 2 unresolved mappings (E05-DMJ at L10, E14-certification at L16) are content gaps, not join gaps — the layers exist structurally, the content is absent. E17-sql-source maps to 'domain-artifact' which is outside the template tree — 1 element with no formal CTB layer target.

state_conflicts.measurement: Count of identity fields where the ORBT/lifecycle state disagrees across authoritative files. heir.yaml says 'build', PROCESS.md says 'OPERATE', orchestrator set run ORBT to 'BUILD'. An agent reading heir.yaml routes to BUILD behavior; reading PROCESS.md routes to OPERATE behavior. Each conflict is a routing fork.
